description: This file appears to be a minified JavaScript source file implementing marker clustering for Google Maps. It manages clusters of markers, calculates bounds, styles icons, and handles user interactions such as clicks and hovers.

classes.name: MarkerClusterer
classes.description: Main class managing the clustering of markers on a Google Map instance.

classes.name: Cluster
classes.description: Represents a group of markers that are clustered together.

classes.name: ClusterIcon
classes.description: Handles the visual representation of a cluster on the map.

methods.name: addMarkers
methods.description: Adds multiple markers to the clusterer.

methods.name: removeMarkers
methods.description: Removes multiple markers from the clusterer.

methods.name: repaint
methods.description: Redraws the clusters on the map.

methods.name: createClusters
methods.description: Creates visual clusters from the marker set based on current zoom and bounds.
